questions.stem: What is the term for a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances?
questions.solution: A solution is a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances, where the components are uniformly distributed at a molecular level. A suspension is a heterogeneous mixture where particles settle over time, and a colloid is a mixture with particles larger than those in a solution but not large enough to settle. A compound is a substance formed by chemical bonds between elements, not a mixture.

hi.stem: दो या दो से अधिक पदार्थों के समांगी मिश्रण के लिए शब्द क्या है?
hi.solution: विलयन दो या दो से अधिक पदार्थों का समांगी मिश्रण होता है, जहां घटक अणुगत स्तर पर एक समान रूप से वितरित होते हैं। अवक्षेपण एक असमांगी मिश्रण है जहां कण समय के साथ नीचे गिर जाते हैं, और कोलॉइड एक मिश्रण है जिसके कण विलयन के कणों की तुलना में बड़े होते हैं लेकिन नीचे गिरने के लिए पर्याप्त बड़े नहीं होते। यौगिक तत्वों के रासायनिक बंधनों द्वारा बना एक पदार्थ होता है, न कि एक मिश्रण।

questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of solution where the solvent is a liquid and the solute is a solid?
questions.solution: A solid in liquid solution occurs when a solid dissolves in a liquid, forming a homogeneous mixture. This matches the description of a solution where the solvent is a liquid and the solute is a solid. A suspension has larger, settling particles and is not homogeneous, while a colloid has particles that are too large to settle but too small to be seen. Gas in gas is a different type of mixture altogether.

hi.solution: ठोस में तरल विलयन तब बनता है जब ठोस एक तरल में घुल जाता है और एक समांगी मिश्रण बनाता है। यह एक विलयन के विवरण के अनुरूप है जहां विलायक एक तरल है और विलेय एक ठोस है। एक अवक्षेप में बड़े कण होते हैं जो बरसात में बैठ जाते हैं और यह समांगी नहीं होता है, जबकि कोलॉइड में कण बरसात में बैठने लायक नहीं होते लेकिन देखे नहीं जा सकते। गैस में गैस एक अलग प्रकार का मिश्रण है।

questions.stem: What is the valency of hydrogen?
questions.solution: Hydrogen has a valency of 1 because it can form one bond with another atom by sharing or transferring an electron. A valency of 2 would mean it can form two bonds, which is not the case for hydrogen. Similarly, valencies of 3 or 4 are incorrect because hydrogen does not have the capacity to form more than one bond.

questions.stem: If a student observes that a substance has a definite volume but no definite shape, which state of matter is it most likely in?
questions.solution: Liquids have a definite volume but take the shape of their container, which matches the observation. Solids have both definite shape and volume, gases have neither, and plastic is not a state of matter. Therefore, the answer is liquid.

questions.stem: If a substance has no definite shape or volume, which state of matter is it most likely in?
questions.solution: Gases do not have a definite shape or volume, as their particles are spread out and move freely. Solids have both definite shape and volume, while liquids have definite volume but not shape. Plastic is not a state of matter but a material, so it is not relevant here. Therefore, the correct answer is gas.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of a homogeneous mixture?
choices: It has two or more phases
questions.solution: A homogeneous mixture has a uniform composition because all its components are evenly distributed throughout. The other options describe characteristics of a heterogeneous mixture, which has a non-uniform composition, visible components, and may have multiple phases.

questions.stem: Based on the experiment described, what happens when iron filings and sulphur are heated together?
choices: They form a mixture that retains the properties of both components
They form a compound that shows new properties
They form a suspension that separates on filtration
They form a colloid that scatters light
questions.solution: When iron filings and sulphur are heated together, a chemical reaction occurs, forming a new substance with properties different from either element. This new substance cannot be separated by physical means and does not retain the original properties of iron or sulphur. A mixture, suspension, or colloid would not exhibit these characteristics.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct characteristic of a colloid?
choices: It can be separated by filtration
questions.solution: Colloids have particles that are larger than those in solutions but smaller than those in suspensions, which causes them to scatter light. This property is known as the Tyndall effect. The other options are incorrect because colloids are heterogeneous, cannot be separated by filtration, and are not always transparent.

questions.stem: A student wrote the formula of a compound formed between Na (valency 1) and O (valency 2) as NaO. What is the correct formula?
questions.solution: Using the cross-multiplication method, Na (valency 1) and O (valency 2) form Na2O. The student forgot to swap the valencies correctly, leading to an incorrect formula. The other options do not follow the method.
